html:
Products / Rash Guards / Tactical Olive

TONTON · CUSTOM RASH GUARD DEVELOPMENT

Tactical Olive Short-Sleeve Compression Rash Guard

A solid olive training reference with a subtle satin-look sheen, raglan panel lines and restrained chest, sleeve and upper-back branding.

  • Short-sleeve, close-fitting silhouette
  • Olive green with a smooth reflective appearance
  • Raglan shoulders and contoured side seams
  • Private-label colors, logos, labels and packaging
Start Your Custom Rash Guard

For BJJ academies, MMA gyms and private-label training collections. Final material, fit and decoration are approved by sample.

What makes Tactical Olive different?

The design focuses on a clean solid-color base rather than full-panel graphics. Gray shadow-style TONTON chest lettering, a light upper-back geometric crest and a sleeve script accent create a compact branding system. Use this reference to brief your own authorized academy or brand artwork.

The satin-look description refers to the visible sheen; it does not specify a satin weave or establish a low-friction test result.

Review the branding and construction details

Upper-back geometric crest

A light tri-line emblem sits below the back collar. Confirm logo dimensions and placement on the assembled sample.

Shadow-style chest typography

Gray chest lettering gives a restrained tonal effect. Confirm decoration method, stretch behavior and finish before production.

Raglan sleeve and cuff finish

Review the sleeve script placement, shoulder seam line and stitched cuff edge. Approve sleeve opening and skin-side comfort on the sample.

The development brief requests four-needle, six-thread flatlock construction. Confirm the selected seam type, thread, recovery and inside finish on the physical sample. Double-row cuff and hem stitching is an approval point, not a guarantee against riding up.

See the Tactical Olive design in motion

Supplied design presentation video. Fabric performance, fit and final branding are checked on the approved physical sample.

Front, back and fit references

Plan a repeatable academy or private-label order

Send your logo, reference color, quantities by size, destination and target delivery date. Review chest and waist fit, sleeve opening, body length, seam comfort, logo stretch and the agreed care cycle before approving bulk production.

Explore custom rash guard manufacturing, compare seam construction and prepare your size and quantity plan.

Buyer questions

Can I customize this olive rash guard for my brand or academy?

Yes. Share your authorized logos, color direction, size allocation, labels and packaging requirements. TONTON will review the decoration method, material and physical sample route for your project.

What are the fabric composition and GSM?

The supplied brief describes a four-way-stretch compression knit. Exact fiber percentages and fabric weight are confirmed against the selected swatch and approved specification; illustrative percentages and GSM ranges are not confirmed values for this reference.

Is the chest logo a raised silicone print?

The chest artwork has a shadow-style appearance in the supplied images. Its physical height and decoration method require sample confirmation. Discuss the desired finish when sending your artwork.

What sizes should I order?

Confirm a finished-garment chart and size grading for your target market. Check chest, waist, body length, sleeve opening and shoulder movement on representative fit samples.

Is this olive colorway competition approved?

No universal competition approval is claimed. Check the current organizer and division requirements for colors, rank identification and garment fit before placing an event order.

What is the minimum order and sample timing?

Selected TONTON custom projects start from 10 pieces, with a target sample window of 3–7 days after usable artwork and product details are confirmed. Final minimums and timing depend on materials, construction and quantities.

Does the video prove fit or performance?

The supplied video is a design presentation. Use a physical sample to approve fabric feel, fit, seams, print and wash care before bulk production.
